data.body: Investigation: ROOT_CAUSE: The candidate-load phase (lines 126-208) calls subprocess ticket show for each candidate ID sequentially. With 144+ candidates at ~0.5-2s per call, total exceeds the 73s Bash tool ceiling. The initial ticket list --format=llm already returns descriptions in the 'desc' field — the per-ticket show loop is redundant. Fix: parse candidate data from the initial list output, eliminating 144 subprocess calls. Confidence: HIGH.
